name: EU Long-Term Resident Status

requirements.blocker_text: Requires 5 years of legal and continuous residence in Cyprus immediately preceding the application. Periods on a student/vocational-training permit, temporary-residence-only status, asylum-seeker status, or under diplomatic conventions do NOT count. Absences under 6 consecutive months (or under 10 months cumulative) do not interrupt continuity.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 5 years' continuous, qualifying legal residence in Cyprus.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires passing the Examinations for the Verification of the Greek Language at A2 level (reading, listening, writing, speaking), held annually each May.
requirements.fix_path: Pass the A2-level Greek language examination.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a stable and regular source of income and health insurance.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 5 years' continuous qualifying legal residence
Proof of stable income and health insurance

sources.title: GK Law Firm -- Long-term resident status after five years in Cyprus
